parts.text: I plan and run our flights, and as the licensed person responsible for each one, I decide which drone flies and along which way, and I sign off a flight before it leaves. Several of us plan at the same time, often for the same busy sites and our popular drones. I want help finding out which of our drones could get to where a job starts, but our policy is that software never chooses a drone or a way for us. I can also call off a flight, and things happen outside our control before and during a flight, such as the load being ready or not, the drone reaching its job points, and the drone arriving.
